svg.title: Form Studio
svg.desc: Form Studio. Describe anything. An engineer-grade agent builds it as real, editable CAD. Two designs written as build123d code and built by the CAD kernel draw themselves as their B-rep edges and fill in: a planetary gear stage (6 parts · 1 : 5 · 91.5 × 91.5 × 22.0 mm) and an ergonomic mouse shell (64.1 × 118.6 × 38.0 mm).
svg.text: An engineer-grade agent builds it as real, editable CAD.
